title: SOUND_LOOK_NO_STALL: P41 sound-cued look plus one no-stall condition (stopped at Step 1: the vetoed pauses share no common cause)
strength_kept: P41: deaths < 40 s 48 -> 47 and 38 = 38; Mac screen means +0.052 / +0.005 with the old 2021 pause gone (F5, F13).
weakness_targeted: Sim Tester's 2 vetoes on #173: stall (b) new 24 s pause on seed 2021 (t 120-144), stall (c) 20 s+ pause games 2 -> 3 on both sets (new 2021 and 5036).

step1.question: What was the look-around doing at each vetoed pause, and do the pauses share one cause a single no-stall condition could remove?
step1.pause_seeds: From the Sim Tester's #173 screen comment: 2021 (2000+3000) and 5036 (4000+5000), the only new 20 s+ pause games. Same pause rule as /workspace/tester/hzlib.py pins(): 10 s windows, in zone, displacement < 3 m, mean move command > 0.3.

table.last_look: episode t 110.7-116.5 (55 ticks, in 'hold' then 'midring settle'), ended 3.5 s before the pause, 22.9 m away
table.sound_looked_at: boost, true source 85 m away, behind a building (sim line-of-sight test), 12 alive
table.goal_heading_in_window: goal oscillation: 'midring settle' (move ~S) <-> 'farm, pickup' (move ~NW), 91 mode switches and 106 move-heading flips > 45 deg in 24 s
table.champion_same_window: the SAME oscillation at the same time: 'midring settle' <-> 'farm, pickup' at (-36.1, 209.6), 33 m away, t 121-154 (about 33 s), 52 heading flips. Its 10 s displacement is 3.08 m, just over the 3 m pause threshold, so the pause rule does not count it
table.cause: Champion's own farm-pickup / midring-settle flip-flop, moved 33 m by the look's earlier torso turn (butterfly). The look was off for the whole pause.

table.last_look: episode t 178.3-181.7 (29 ticks, 'to next circle'), ended 89.3 s before the pause, 208.8 m away
table.sound_looked_at: boost, true source 75 m away, behind a building, 11 alive (all 6 episodes in this game: boost sounds behind buildings)
table.goal_heading_in_window: no oscillation: 'drop, run' with a constant move (0, -1), 4 heading flips and 6 mode switches in 29 s. Stuck at (155.35, 203.0) bouncing on a ledge (z 3.7-17.4 m, rarely grounded) with energy 14; it got over at t about 299 once energy refilled to 72 during 'heal'
table.champion_same_window: dead (8th, 154.75 s); the champion never reaches t 271 in this game
table.cause: Drop-run ledge climb with too little energy (jet-starved), 147 s after the games diverged, during life the champion never had. The look was off for the whole pause.

step1.look_source_cover_base_2000: P41 c21d23b traced on all 96 games of base 2000 (rows identical to /workspace/tester/runs/trees-c21d23b-2000.csv on every non-timing column, 96/96): look episodes in 16 games; source behind a building 8, behind trees 8, in the open 8. Hidden sources are a normal look target (16/24), not a pause-game marker. 20 s+ pause games on base 2000: 2021 (new) and 2047 (champion's own, unchanged).
step1.verdict: NO COMMON CAUSE. The 2 vetoed pauses (2021, 5036) have different mechanisms: a goal flip-flop the champion also has at the same time (2021), and a jet-starved drop-run ledge stall in extra lifetime the champion never had (5036). The look was off in both windows (0 ticks). The only shared element is the divergence trigger itself (a look at a building-hidden boost sound), which describes 2/3 of all looks and does not separate pause games from the rest. Fewer than 2/3 of the pauses share a cause, so no single no-stall condition is justified.
step1.method: Copies of the champion (b9492c6 bot files) and P41 (c21d23b bot files, EARS_LOOK_ON true) under /tmp/p41b, each run with a passive per-tick trace wrapper (pos, z, energy, move, aim, draw label, sounds, drops); a copy of /workspace/wt-tester-trees/tools/sim at /tmp/p41b/sim, with one env-gated addition (P41B_SRC) that attaches each sound's true source, distance and building/tree line-of-sight test to obs.sounds as extra fields the bots never read. `cd /tmp/p41b/sim && P41B_SRC=1 TR_DIR=<dir> SEED_BASE=<seed> bun tools/sim/run.ts --bot /tmp/p41b/wrap-<tag>.ts --seeds 1 --jobs 1 --kit /workspace/mechfight-kit --out <csv> --trees`. Passivity: 2021 and 5036 rows equal the Sim Tester's trees-b9492c6 and trees-c21d23b rows for both bots; base 2000 P41 rows equal on 96/96. Traces in /tmp/p41b (not committed).

hypothesis: The P41 sound-cued look's vetoed 20 s+ pauses share one cause that a single extra condition on the look can remove, keeping its deaths < 40 s gain.
mechanism: Not built. Step 1 found no shared cause to gate on.
activation: P41 on P48 (Step A, P41.json): 29/192 and 25/192 games. Not re-measured for P41b (no build).
positives: Step 1 facts: (1) the 2021 'new spot' pause is the champion's own farm-pickup / midring-settle flip-flop, which the champion also does at the same time 33 m away; the pause rule misses the champion's copy by 0.08 m (10 s displacement 3.08 m vs 3 m). (2) The 5036 pause occurs only because P41 lived 166 s longer (8th -> 2nd).
negatives: No single no-stall condition on the look fits both pauses; the look was inactive in both pause windows.
confidence: Uncertain (2 pause games; traced, isolated and reproduced exactly)
reuse: The champion's farm-pickup / midring-settle flip-flop (seen in P48 itself on 2021 at t 121-154) is a separate champion weakness a future single change could target. P41 itself, as far as these traces show, does not cause stalls directly; the vetoes are downstream divergence.
disproof: Stop with no PR if activation < 10/192 on either set (Step A), or the fix removes the deaths < 40 s gain, or new >= 20 s pauses remain. Step 1 precondition (brief 1:20 AM ET): stop if fewer than 2/3 of the vetoed pauses share a common cause.
success_criterion: No new >= 20 s pauses vs P48 and deaths < 40 s gain kept (not reached: stopped at Step 1).
differs_from_P41: Would have added ONE no-stall condition to P41's look; none was justified by the traces.
decision: Stopped at Step 1 (no common cause). No build, no flag, no PR.
blocker: No common cause among the vetoed pauses.
next_action: Coordinator: decide whether the 2021 veto should stand given the champion's own same-time flip-flop (3.08 m, uncounted), and whether a champion-side farm-pickup / midring-settle flip-flop fix is worth its own record.
